title: THE FOUR STARTER GUNS ARE GONE
why: His order of 2026-10-14: get rid of the Sputter, Tacker, Chatter and Scuttle, he never understood why they were in the game. The four issued starter guns are out of the weapon table and out of every table that listed them: the gun ranks, the shot voices (and the rattle only the Sputter used), the draw times, the gear sounds, the held gun sprites, the icon families and the old save migration, and the starter list is gone. Pillagers and hired men now carry real lootable guns on the three sidearm rows that used to carry the Tacker: one row the Magnum and two the Compact SMG, so the Compact SMG is the commonest gun on a pillager and the lower tiers lead. An imported friend who favoured the Scav Pistol walks in with the Magnum, and the DEMO kit swaps the Chatter in its second gun list for the Auto Rifle. The gun on those three rows is in the pillager hands only, with no copy for his body, so the share of pillagers who drop a gun is exactly what it was (the Tacker never dropped, and the other six rows drop theirs as before); an elite blessed with a gun drops it as before. No seeded draw moved: every pick draws once from the same length list, so the seed 4242 raid keeps its 85 and 374 entities and its 165 and 593 containers. The one loaner draw the bot sim still makes is the same single draw from four real guns (the Scav Pistol, Compact SMG, Auto Rifle and Riot Scattergun), and a live raid draws it and drops it as before.
now: The Tacker, Sputter, Chatter and Scuttle are gone: pillagers carry real lootable guns and the DEMO kit deals real guns.
